RehgarLightningShieldStormcaller.name: Stormcaller
RehgarLightningShieldStormcaller.description: Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%. Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 300 times.

RehgarEarthbindTotemColossalTotem.name: Colossal Totem
RehgarEarthbindTotemColossalTotem.description: Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast. Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

RehgarFeralHeart.name: Feral Heart
RehgarFeralHeart.description: Ghost Wolf's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 40% for the first second, then falls to 30%. Entering or exiting Ghost Wolf form grants 15 Armor for 1 second.

RehgarEarthlivingEnchant.name: Earthliving Enchant
RehgarEarthlivingEnchant.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds.

RehgarLightningShieldElectricCharge.name: Electric Charge
RehgarLightningShieldElectricCharge.description: The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar. While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

RehgarHealingTotem.name: Healing Totem
RehgarHealingTotem.description: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125 (+4% per level) Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

RehgarEarthbindTotemGroundedTotem.name: Grounded Totem
RehgarEarthbindTotemGroundedTotem.description: Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 25% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%. Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's range by 50%.

RehgarPurification.name: Purification
RehgarPurification.description: If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220 (+4% per level). Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330 (+4% per level) damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds. Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds

RehgarBloodAndThunder.name: Blood and Thunder
RehgarBloodAndThunder.description: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 5% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

RehgarAncestralHealing.name: Ancestral Healing
RehgarAncestralHealing.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

RehgarBloodlust.name: Bloodlust
RehgarBloodlust.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

RehgarMasteryTidalWaves.name: Tidal Waves
RehgarMasteryTidalWaves.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

RehgarLightningShieldEarthShield.name: Earth Shield
RehgarLightningShieldEarthShield.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

RehgarWellspring.name: Wellspring
RehgarWellspring.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

RehgarLightningShieldRisingStorm.name: Rising Storm
RehgarLightningShieldRisingStorm.description: Every time a Lighting Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times. Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

RehgarEarthbindTotemEarthgraspTotem.name: Earthgrasp Totem
RehgarEarthbindTotemEarthgraspTotem.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 115 (+4% per level) damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

RehgarHungerOfTheWolf.name: Hunger of the Wolf
RehgarHungerOfTheWolf.description: Ghost Wolf attacks against Heroes deal an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health and heal Rehgar for 6% of his maximum Health.

RehgarAncestralHealingFarseersBlessing.name: Farseer's Blessing
RehgarAncestralHealingFarseersBlessing.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590 (+4% per level).

RehgarGladiatorsWarShout.name: Gladiator's War Shout
RehgarGladiatorsWarShout.description: Increase the duration and range of Bloodlust by 100%.

RehgarElementalConduit.name: Elemental Conduit
RehgarElementalConduit.description: Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds. For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their ma

RehgarPitFighter.name: Pit Fighter
RehgarPitFighter.description: Gain 10% increased Attack Damage and 3 Spell Power. Each nearby ally Hero grants an additional stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks. While at 2 or more stacks, Purge's cooldown refreshes 50% faster.
